Dimensions: Amazon lists 13 x 15.25 x 14.5 in, which reads as package size. Not recorded as machine size.

ownerThemes.theme: Reviewers describe the DX as the same machine as the 1034D with a brighter LED, a deeper trim trap and dials moved to the right side; opinions on whether that is worth the extra cost are split.
Threading order and the lower looper path are the main hurdle for new owners; walkthroughs say route the lower looper thread left and under the foot.

crossShop.why: Nearly identical specs; the D is usually cheaper and has a longer track record.
Adds 2-thread stitches, 1,500 spm and a heavier build for a modest premium.
Dealer-sold entry serger with 2/3/4 thread and 1,500 spm at around $499.

editorial.verdict: The 1034DX is the 1034D with an LED light, a larger trim trap and right-side dials; buy on price, because the stitch specs are the same.
editorial.whoFor: A first serger buyer who finds the DX at or near the 1034D price and wants the brighter light and tidier trim catch.
editorial.skipIf: The DX costs meaningfully more than the 1034D where you shop, or you want 2-thread or air threading.
strengths: Same 1,300 spm and 0.7 to 2.0 differential feed as the 1034D.
LED light and a deeper removable trim trap, per comparison reviews.
25-year limited warranty with lifetime phone support, per Brother.
weaknesses: Brother does not publish weight or dimensions on the page captured; dealer figures disagree.
Manual lay-in threading; the lower looper path trips up new owners.

checks.title: Compare against the 1034D price the same day
checks.body: The two machines share stitch specs. If the DX is more than about $50 higher, the extras are an LED, a trim trap and dial placement.

checks.title: Bundle contents
checks.body: The Amazon listing includes three feet, a cover, a DVD, a needle set, a trim trap and four spools. Other sellers may drop the spools or feet.

checks.title: Needle type
checks.body: Brother's page does not name the needle system in the snippet captured. Confirm it takes 130/705H household needles like the 1034D before stocking up.
